+Ablation of Boundary-Anchored Memorization-Gated Orthogonal Ascent (BAMOA) for
+ACDC patient-level unlearning that REMOVES the PCGrad-style ascent/retain
+orthogonalisation: the raw forget ascent gradient flows into the composed
+update unmodified (no projection against the retain gradient). Every other

+optimizer epochs beyond that step, so the <=80-RPC bound on OFFERED updates
+also bounds the candidate's steps.
